mentions.name: Academic Branch Prediction Championship
mentions.description: An academic championship competition for branch predictors that, unlike prior championships, incorporates real-world design constraints such as prediction latency and energy consumption. It is open to everyone, with documentation and a tutorial on the website/repository to help participants get started.
mentions.problem: Real-world design constraints, such as how long a prediction takes to produce and how much energy it consumes, have never been seriously considered in previous branch prediction championships.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am organizing an academic branch prediction championship: https://cbp-ng.bpchamp.com/

This is not the first championship in branch prediction, but real-world design constraints have never been seriously considered before (How long does it take to produce a prediction? How much energy does it consume?).
